packs.title: Hills & Water
packs.promise: Explore music, city heights, water-powered motion and a public palace view.

q.s: Collect a music object, a room detail and the interpretation that connects them.
st: Enter Mozart Residence under valid admission around 10:40–11:00; standard adult €18 or applicable reduced / free entitlement with proof. Children younger than 14 need an adult. Travel light: large backpacks, travel bags and trolleys are prohibited, with no guarded cloakroom. Normal opening is 09:00–17:30, last admission 17:00; check dated holiday or early-closing exceptions before travel. If bringing an animal, confirm admission with the museum before travel: its current English house rules exclude animals except certified and registered assistance dogs, while its current FAQ names marked and registered assistance dogs and permits private dogs carried in a bag throughout without disturbing the visit. These sections conflict; a carrier bag alone does not establish admission.
In an open visitor room, find one music-related object or illustrated object, one spatial detail of its setting, and one interpretation panel that connects music with life in this house.

Record the object and room detail, then distinguish what the museum explicitly explains from your own inference. Use notes; any photographs must remain private and non-flash, following room restrictions.

Choose the strongest connection and explain why its evidence is stronger than your inference. Leave time for the Imbergstiege ascent; the next 400 m / 6 min measured link needs about 20 min with stairs and rest.

q.s: Make two different views from one public terrace.
st: From the museum visitor route, use signs to the actual lower public museum viewing terrace. The measured outdoor approach is 77 m / 1 min; allow 15 min in total for exit finding, this walk and its return. No café seat or purchase is needed.
Choose a safe inward public position. Make two small word-frames or sketches of the same roofs: one close and one including a longer surrounding line.
Revise one frame so the roofline takes a different role. Describe the effect without claiming the city should look one particular way.
Retrace the same short open path and finish the lift’s return observation. If mobility access matters, confirm current terrace arrangements with staff before travel.

q.s: Collect three aircraft features and test the job you assign each.
st: Begin this roughly 5-hour outing at Hauptbahnhof around 10:30 on a compatible ordinary Wednesday. Check Hangar-7’s dated notices and group preregistration requirement. Buy / validate the bus ticket before boarding; standard adult core-zone hour €2.60 or valid entitlement with required proof.

Use Line 2 toward Wals / Walserfeld, alight Karolingerstraße and follow permitted pavements to Hangar-7’s signed visitor entrance. The named approach is 700 m / 9 min; allow 20 min for the actual stop side, crossings and door finding. Individual admission is free; no dining or purchase is needed.

From visitor areas, collect three features on displayed aircraft: a supporting structure, a moving or control surface, and a visible arrangement related to the aircraft’s use. Pair each with a job, marking whether that job comes from a label or your inference.
Choose one inference that a label supports or changes. Record the three pairs, then use the 3.4 km / 47 min public street connector toward the pond; allow 60 min with crossings and rest.

packs.title: Signs & Courts
packs.promise: Read the Old Town through signs, evidence, public shapes and quiet paths.

q.s: Build three evidence cards from a birthplace museum.
st: Enter around 12:20–12:40 with valid admission: standard adult €18 or applicable reduced / free entitlement with accepted proof. Children younger than 14 need an adult; confirm the conflicting age-six tariff if relevant. This museum is not barrier-free. Large backpacks, travel bags and trolleys cannot enter, and there is no guarded cloakroom. Normal opening is 09:00–17:30, last admission 17:00; check dated holiday or early-closing exceptions before travel. If bringing an animal, confirm admission with the museum before travel: its current English house rules exclude animals except certified and registered assistance dogs, while its current FAQ names marked and registered assistance dogs and permits private dogs carried in a bag throughout without disturbing the visit. These sections conflict; a carrier bag alone does not establish admission.

Make three small evidence cards from actual labels: one Salzburg or household connection, one named person or relationship, and one journey or later-work connection. Identify the object, image or panel behind each fact.
Place the cards in an order that explains one connection. Use only dates or relationships the museum actually supplies; leave an uncertain sequence marked uncertain.

Write why you chose that order. Photographs, if permitted in the room, are private non-flash only. Continue by the measured 250 m / 3 min public street route through Rathausplatz, Sigmund-Haffner-Gasse and Ritzerbogen; do not use an unverified shortcut through the museum block.

q.s: Make a small original response to an oversized public sculpture.
st: From the market, use the 98 m / 1 min public approach to Furtwänglerpark and allow 5 min to find the oversized Gurken sculptures. Stay on permitted paving; Awilda in Dietrichsruh is a different artwork.
Choose one cucumber form. Make a tiny response in four original lines or a simple sketch, keeping one visible feature and changing its scale or relationship to another form.
Revise one line or shape to make your choice clearer. Describe what you borrowed from observation and what you invented yourself.
Keep the response as your own interpretation, without assigning humour or intention to the artist. Continue by the 500 m / 7 min public route through Franziskanergasse and Domplatz; allow 10 min.

q.s: Turn four different edges into one short arrangement.
st: After the museum, follow the 82 m / 1 min exterior square link and choose an open public position, outside the fountain basin and any event boundary.
Find four different edges around the square: building, opening, roof or ground line. Describe each by side and feature without needing a building entry.
Make a four-line arrangement in which one edge leads and another interrupts it. Revise the order once and explain what changed.
Keep your original arrangement, then follow the 270 m / 4 min public route via Domplatz, Kapitelplatz and Festungsgasse to the lower funicular visitor entrance.
